title: Bo Nix ahead of schedule in his rehab, should be ready for OTAs

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bo Nix ahead of schedule in his rehab, should be ready for OTAs
sources.description: Broncos quarterback Bo Nix is ahead of schedule in his rehab from ankle surgery that ended his season, team owner Greg Penner said Monday at the NFL owners meetings.
